target_customer: Frontier AI labs that buy human preference data and evaluations, plus consumers who use the free arena
problem: AI model benchmarks do not capture taste or aesthetics in generated designs, and labs need human judgments of visual quality.
business_model: Free consumer arena that generates preference data sold as private evaluations, datasets, analytics and leaderboard API access
product_category: Crowdsourced AI design benchmark and human evaluation

competitors.name: LMArena WebDev Arena
competitors.what: Head-to-head crowdsourced benchmark for AI web app generation

technical_complexity.rationale: A pairwise voting site with Bradley-Terry ranking and calls to many model APIs is straightforward engineering; scale and abuse control are the work.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated votes and users feed a data asset labs pay for, but LMArena and others can add design categories.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: LMArena already ran WebDev Arena and later launched Code Arena (Nov 2025); no acquisition of Design Arena found, and a rival (Yupp) shut down in 2026 per press.

market_need_then: Labs needed taste and aesthetics signals that standard benchmarks lack; the founders say a frontier lab became a customer within about a week of recognizing labs would pay (interview coverage).

identity.visual_style: Collage of AI model logos on the site

branding.brand_signature: The arena format with model leaderboards
branding.community_and_virality: Reported 47K users in 4 weeks per YC launch page and claims of millions of users later (self reported); gained Gigazine and TechCrunch coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear category name that borrowed the arena pattern from LMArena and gained press, but descriptive and generic; some sources say it operates publicly as Intelligence, creating a second name.

pivots.to: Head-to-head benchmark of AI generated design
pivots.why: Founders built a comparison tool instead, per interview coverage (secondary source).

outcome_analysis: Design Arena grew from a Harvard hackathon game engine into a crowdsourced design benchmark launched on Hacker News in August 2025, then sold preference data to AI labs and announced a $7.9M seed led by Index in August 2026. It benefited from the AI model race and the arena pattern LMArena proved, while competing against LMArena itself. Revenue claims of $60M ARR come from secondary sources and are unverified.
notes: The seed is confirmed by TechCrunch plus a second outlet (aiweekly) and Sacra; Sacra also lists YC among participants (not recorded). The $60M ARR claim appears only in secondary blogs and is unverified. The company reportedly operates publicly as Intelligence with legal entity Arcada Labs Inc. VCBacked's $500K total is stale. Confidence high because founders, competition and funding all have cited sources.
